summary: Cash posting slice: draft cash transactions become immutable posted facts with exactly one canonical cash.transaction_recorded event, read-only account coverage estimates and a tightened posting guard. No ledger posting, classification, clearing, refund, correction, transfer, import or opening balance; PH-169/170/171 stay proposed.

review.reviewer: independent PH-230 implementation reviewer (fresh context, read-only; multi-round)
findings: Round 1 major fixed: the 0003 SQLite guard now freezes created_by_id/created_at and requires version=OLD.version+1 on the draft->posted transition (PostgreSQL guard also enforces version+1); a direct-update regression test rejects created_by/created_at/gross/version tampering while normal posting still succeeds with version+1.

Round 1 major fixed: verify_integrity now validates the full canonical envelope (schema_version, topic, organization_id, event_id, data.source equal to transaction_ref including version, changed_refs=[ref], posting_event_refs=[]) and requires the cash_transaction.post receipt for posted facts, on top of exactly-one-event, no draft events, non-future posting and no cash accounting events/claims.

Retained minors: duplicate-post business error text is not rendered on the posted detail page (400, no 500, state unchanged); omitted vs explicit occurred_on/posting_period produce different receipt digests for the same token (low risk); a dedicated posting race for revocation/module-disable after lock wait can be added later; browser is Chromium-only; classification/clearing/production remain future slices.
review.evidence: Reviewer rechecked HEAD 5609022 after the fixes: 0003 trigger probes (created_by/created_at updates rejected with IntegrityError), canonical envelope tampering rejected by verify_integrity, full suite 723 OK/45 skip, cash target 30 OK, fresh-migrated and real cash databases verify_integrity ok:true, browser 29/29 on unchanged UI. Formal PASS is conditional on the PR PostgreSQL CI executing all 5 cash concurrency tests successfully.

deviations: No canonical cash.transaction.record/v1 channel is exposed; posting is a private service operating on an already-registered draft id to avoid a second write path.

Only one canonical cash.transaction_recorded.v1 event is written per posted transaction; a suppressed plugin.* audit is used as the DomainEvent source to avoid the OneToOne source conflict, while a generic cash.cash_transaction.posted audit records the business action.
Coverage is a private estimate (posted_net_estimate_cents/available_estimate_cents, cleared=0), labelled as not cash balance or available balance; canonical cash.account_coverage.get is deferred.
Posted time is derived from the latest posting audit timestamp; no posted_at field was added.

Posting guards also freeze created_by/created_at and require version=OLD.version+1 on the draft->posted transition in both SQLite and PostgreSQL; verify_integrity validates the full canonical event envelope (source/version/payload/event_id) and the posting receipt.
unverified: PostgreSQL concurrency (5 tests incl. double posting) is executed by the PR CI job; local SQLite skips are not evidence.
Cash classification, ledger bridge, clearing (PH-170), refunds (PH-171), bank-file import, opening balances, production/customer UAT remain unverified/not implemented; PH-169 is not complete.
Browser evidence covers Chromium 320/390/768/1024/1440 only; printing/dark mode/touch/non-Chromium untested.
Duplicate-post business error text is not rendered on the posted detail page (returns 400, no 500, state unchanged); deferred to a later UX fix.
Omitted vs explicit occurred_on/posting_period form different receipt digests for the same token (low-risk idempotency edge); no state corruption.
A dedicated posting race after lock-wait for membership revocation/module disable is not covered yet; single-threaded revocation/disable rejections are covered.
